answer_1.quote: We propose a new paradigm: Dynamic granularity TimELine Summarization (DTELS).
answer_1.outputs: timelines of chronologically ordered summaries of news events at different granularities

answer_2.quote: We propose metrics that address the aforementioned criteria: Informativeness: This metric evaluates the effective volume of information in the node summaries. We propose a "mount-then-measure" paradigm to align predicted node summaries to those in the reference timeline based on the entailment score of the "event atoms", which represents the smallest unit of event information within a sentence.

answer_3.quote: We adopt this metric for our task, ensuring that summaries are generated in a structurally, linguistically, and stylistically coherent manner. To facilitate this, we design a review form to guide the most advanced LLMs for coherence evaluation.

answer_4.quote: Annotators are asked to rate timelines on a scale from 1 to 5 based on the metrics. Pearson correlations are: informativeness (78.74%), granular consistency (76.66%), factuality (95.87%), and coherence (99.14%).
answer_4.guideline: We have each evaluator independently assess the timelines using the scoring sheets in Figure.
